name: Central Provident Fund
authority: Central Provident Fund Act 1953, section 7 and First Schedule; CPF Board contribution tables effective 1 January 2025, Tables 1–5. Ordinary Wages are capped at SGD 7,400 per month. Additional Wages, including bonuses and leave encashment, use the SGD 102,000 annual ceiling less the year's capped Ordinary Wages. Before year end, remaining Ordinary Wages are projected; year-end and departure calculations reconcile against actual wages. Cash wage allowances enter their declared Ordinary or Additional Wage part; official expense reimbursements do not. Rate bands change in the month after the relevant birthday. SPR year two starts in the month after the first anniversary; year three starts in the month after the second anniversary. First- and second-year SPRs use graduated rates unless CPF Board approves full employer/full employee or full employer/graduated employee rates. These are separate elections with an approval reference. The total contribution rounds half-up to whole dollars, the employee share rounds down, and the employer pays the difference. name: Chinese Development Assistance Council Fund
authority: CPF Board self-help group contribution schedule: Chinese Development Assistance Council Fund. Monthly employee-borne wage-band deductions apply to Chinese Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents. The base includes cash wage allowances, overtime and leave encashment, less unpaid absence; official expense reimbursements are excluded. The published wage band applies unless a dated fund instruction records an opt-out or a different monthly amount. Explicit zero is distinct from no instruction. The instruction reference is required; MBMF changes use the approved total after any component changes. CPF Board: https://www.cpf.gov.sg/employer/employer-obligations/contributions-to-self-help-groups . CDAC employer FAQ 18 allows an employee with multiple jobs to opt out for selected employers: https://www.cdac.org.sg/cdac-funding-info-information-for-employers .

rules.refusal: Record the employee’s race as shown on the NRIC: CDAC is deducted from every Chinese citizen or permanent resident unless they opt out in writing, so an unrecorded race cannot be read as outside the fund.
"Choose an opt-out or a monthly amount, not both."
"The approved monthly fund amount must use whole cents."

name: Skills Development Levy
authority: Skills Development Levy Act 1979 s.3 with the Skills Development Levy Order — 0.25% of the first SGD 4,500 of monthly remuneration, a minimum of SGD 2 for an employee earning less than SGD 800 a month and a maximum of SGD 11.25 for one earning more than SGD 4,500. The three bands below carry the minimum, the rate and the maximum; the levy is employer-borne. A month in which no remuneration is payable attracts no levy, which is why the first band opens at SGD 0.01. Base: allowances are wages (CPF Act 1953 s.2 'wages': all remuneration in money including allowances; the SDL Order and the self-help-group schedules read total wages), so `ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward) is in every base; a reimbursement row must be excluded by name.
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) + ENCASHMENT - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE

name: Chinese Development Assistance Council Fund
authority: CPF Board self-help group contribution schedule: Chinese Development Assistance Council Fund. Monthly employee-borne wage-band deductions apply to Chinese Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents. The base includes cash wage allowances, overtime and leave encashment, less unpaid absence; official expense reimbursements are excluded. The published wage band applies unless a dated fund instruction records an opt-out or a different monthly amount. Explicit zero is distinct from no instruction. The instruction reference is required; MBMF changes use the approved total after any component changes. CPF Board: https://www.cpf.gov.sg/employer/employer-obligations/contributions-to-self-help-groups . CDAC employer FAQ 18 allows an employee with multiple jobs to opt out for selected employers: https://www.cdac.org.sg/cdac-funding-info-information-for-employers .

rules.refusal: Record the employee’s race as shown on the NRIC: CDAC is deducted from every Chinese citizen or permanent resident unless they opt out in writing, so an unrecorded race cannot be read as outside the fund.
"Choose an opt-out or a monthly amount, not both."
"The approved monthly fund amount must use whole cents."

name: Skills Development Levy
authority: Skills Development Levy Act 1979 s.3 with the Skills Development Levy Order — 0.25% of the first SGD 4,500 of monthly remuneration, a minimum of SGD 2 for an employee earning less than SGD 800 a month and a maximum of SGD 11.25 for one earning more than SGD 4,500. The three bands below carry the minimum, the rate and the maximum; the levy is employer-borne. A month in which no remuneration is payable attracts no levy, which is why the first band opens at SGD 0.01. Base: allowances are wages (CPF Act 1953 s.2 'wages': all remuneration in money including allowances; the SDL Order and the self-help-group schedules read total wages), so `ALLOWANCES` and `ADHOC` (each class listing the scheme in its counts_toward) is in every base; a reimbursement row must be excluded by name.
assessed_on: BASE + OVERTIME + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) + ENCASHMENT - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE
